sn35.55:1.1: kathaṃ nu kho bhante jānato kathaṃ passato saññojanā samugghātaṃ gacchantīti.
sn35.55:1.2: cakkhuṃ kho bhikkhave anattato jānato passato saññojanā samugghātaṃ gacchanti
sn35.55:1.6: yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi anattato jānato passato saññojanā samugghātaṃ gacchanti.
sn35.55:1.15: yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi anattato jānato passato saññojanā samugghātaṃ gacchanti.
sn35.55:1.16: evaṃ kho bhikkhave jānato evaṃ passato saññojanā samugghātaṃ gacchantīti.
